APPROVE

The extracted `BypassedCtorFqns` helper applies the same filters as the original loops (Scala types only, non-empty `CtorFqn`, ordinal comparer), so behaviour is unchanged. The removed nested loops and ifs bring the method well under 15, and the file already uses LINQ (`.Any` in `AssertsNonEmptinessByName`), so it should build.

I judged this from the diff alone, without building the project or running the tests.
